newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek Uncle Stathis says 96 profit up 136p.
newsitem.headline: Greek Uncle Stathis says 96 profit up 136p.

text.p: Greek frozen foods firm Uncle Stathis told institutional investors on Wednesday, its 1996 pretax profit rose 136.1 percent to 718 million drachmas from 304 million in 1995.
Its turnover rose 7.12 percent to 8.686 billion drachmas from 8.108 billion in 1995.
Uncle Stathis was bought by Delta Dairy in 1994 and was merged with Froza, another frozen foods company owned by Delta.
Its new name is Geniki Trophimon S.A. A minority stake was sold by the Delta Group to tobacco firm Papastratos.

Geniki Trophimon specialises in the areas of frozen vegetables and potatoes, where it has established a 69 percent domestic market share. It also comprises 20 percent of the Greek frozen dough market.
The company also engages in the production of frozen fruits, which are exports to Western European countries.

"The Western European market is big and has more potential. Exports rose in the last few years. Greece has a competitive advantage in this area," officials said in a company report presented to insitutions.
